summary: Obsidian Energy Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting its first-quarter 2026 financial and operating results. The disclosure includes production figures, funds flow from operations of $61.0 million, capital expenditures, and net debt. The registrant also notes the renewal of its normal course issuer bid and repurchase of ~1.5 million shares. There is no transaction, strategic review, activist campaign, or special-situation event being announced. This is a routine earnings release on Form 6-K, equivalent to a standard quarterly report. No analysis of a special situation is warranted.
